headline: Stratage Law Partners, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas act on Nutriventia securing investment from Ndude Labs
sum: Nutriventia Private Limited has secured an investment from Ndude Labs by way of allotment of shares of to Ndude Labs. Stratage Law Partners advised Nutriventia on this transaction.
detail: Nutriventia Private Limited has secured an investment from Ndude Labs by way of allotment of shares of to Ndude Labs. Stratage Law Partners advised Nutriventia on this transaction. The Firm's role included reviewing, negotiating and finalization of the transaction documents, along with the finalization of conditions precedent and closing actions. The transaction team consisted of Darshan Upadhyay (Managing Partner), Soumya Shanker (Partner), Abhay Gaur (Senior Associate) and Gaurav Deep Agrawal (Associate).
